newsitem.title: CHINA: Exxon plans China lube oil blending plants.
newsitem.headline: Exxon plans China lube oil blending plants.

text.p: Exxon Corp.'s Esso unit said Wednesday it would begin construction of two lubricating oil blending plants in China.
Esso said it would start construction on Thursday of a plant in the northern city of Tianjin and would begin work later this month on the second plant in the eastern city of Ningbo.
It did not say how much it would spend on the plants, both of which would have a capacity of 250,000 barrels per year on completion in 1998.
The plants were part of a strategy to expand Esso's presence in the rapidly growing lubricants market in China, the company said.

"By the turn of the century, we expect the demand for finished lubricants in China to exceed 3 million (metric) tons per year," Khoo Hong Chuan, chairman and managing director of Esso's Esso (Tianjin) Co. Ltd. said in a statement.
Exxon's stock fell $1 to $105.875 early on the New York Stock Exchange.
